reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1684 c, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَحَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِلْوَلِيدِ وَحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، وَعَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُ السَّارِقِ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir, Harmalah ibn Yahya, and al-Walid ibn Shuja' narrated to me. The wording is al-Walid's and Harmalah's. They said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah and 'Amrah, from 'A'ishah, from the Messenger of Allah, who said: A thief's hand is not cut off unless the stolen amount is a quarter of a dinar or more.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1684 d, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ وَأَحْمَدَ - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ الْيَدُ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَمَا فَوْقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir, Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli, and Ahmad ibn 'Isa narrated to me. The wording is Harun's and Ahmad's. Abu al-Tahir said: Ibn Wahb informed us; the other two said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Makhramah informed me, from his father, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from 'Amrah, who heard 'A'ishah say that she heard the Messenger of Allah say: The hand is not cut off except for a quarter of a dinar or more.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1684 e, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ يَدُ السَّارِقِ إِلاَّ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Bishr ibn al-Hakam al-'Abdi narrated to me: 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from Yazid ibn 'Abdullah ibn al-Had, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad, from 'Amrah, from 'A'ishah, who heard the Prophet say: A thief's hand is not cut off unless the stolen amount is a quarter of a dinar or more.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1684 f, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، - مِنْ وَلَدِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, and Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us, all from Abu 'Amir al-'Aqadi: 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far, a descendant of al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, narrated to us: Yazid ibn 'Abdullah ibn al-Had narrated to us with this chain, with the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1685 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمْ تُقْطَعْ يَدُ سَارِقٍ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الْمِجَنِّ حَجَفَةٍ أَوْ تُرْسٍ وَكِلاَهُمَا ذُو ثَمَنٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: Humayd ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ru'asi narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwah, from his father, from 'A'ishah, who said: A thief's hand was not cut off during the Messenger of Allah's time for less than the price of a shield, whether a small shield or a large one; both had value.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1685 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، الرُّؤَاسِيِّ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ وَأَبِي أُسَامَةَ وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ذُو ثَمَنٍ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Abdah ibn Sulayman and Humayd ibn 'Abd al-Rahman informed us. Another chain: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman narrated to us. Another chain: Abu Kurayb narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us. All of them reported from Hisham with this chain, like the hadith of Ibn Numayr from Humayd ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ru'asi. In the report of 'Abd al-Rahim and Abu Usamah it adds: and it had value at that time.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1686 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَطَعَ سَارِقًا فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلاَثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: I read to Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that the Messenger of Allah cut off a thief's hand for a shield valued at three dirhams.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1686 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، وَأَيُّوبَ، بْنِ مُوسَى وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ ح. وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الْجُمَحِيِّ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، وَمَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، وَأُسَامَةَ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ قَالَ قِيمَتُهُ وَبَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ ثَمَنُهُ ثَلاَثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Ibn Rumh narrated to us, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. Another chain: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us; they said: Yahya, meaning al-Qattan, narrated to us. Another chain: Ibn Numayr narrated to us: my father narrated to us. Another chain: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us. All of them reported from 'Ubaydullah. Another chain: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Isma'il, meaning Ibn 'Ulayyah, narrated to us. Another chain: Abu al-Rabi' and Abu Kamil narrated to us; they said: Hammad narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to me: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Sufyan informed us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, Ayyub ibn Musa, and Isma'il ibn Umayyah. Another chain: 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi narrated to me: Abu Nu'aym informed us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub, Isma'il ibn Umayyah, 'Ubaydullah, and Musa ibn 'Uqbah. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj informed us: Isma'il ibn Umayyah informed me. Another chain: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us, from Hanzalah ibn Abi Sufyan al-Jumahi, 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Umar, Malik ibn Anas, and Usamah ibn Zayd al-Laythi, all from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet, with the like of Yahya's hadith from Malik. Some said its value, and some said its price: three dirhams.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1687 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ السَّارِقَ يَسْرِقُ الْبَيْضَةَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ وَيَسْرِقُ الْحَبْلَ فَتُقْطَعُ يَدُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us; they said: Abu Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said: May Allah curse the thief: he steals an egg and his hand is cut off, and he steals a rope and his hand is cut off.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1687 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ السَّرِقَةِ وَنِصَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عِيسَى، بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ سَرَقَ حَبْلاً وَإِنْ سَرَقَ بَيْضَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, and 'Ali ibn Khashram narrated to us, all reporting from 'Isa ibn Yunus, from al-A'mash, with this chain, with the like of it, except that he said: If he steals a rope or an egg.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1688 a, book 29, باب قَطْعِ السَّارِقِ الشَّرِيفِ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالنَّهْىِ عَنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ فِي الْحُدُودِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنَ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا، أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فَقَالُوا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَاخْتَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ رُمْحٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: al-Layth narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Rumh informed us: al-Layth informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah, that the Quraysh were concerned about the Makhzumi woman who had stolen. They asked who would speak to the Messenger of Allah about her, and said that only Usamah, the beloved of the Messenger of Allah, would dare. Usamah spoke to him. The Messenger of Allah asked whether he was interceding concerning one of Allah's limits. Then he stood and addressed the people: The people before you were destroyed because when a high-ranking person stole, they let him go, but when a weak person stole, they carried out the prescribed punishment. By Allah, if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad were to steal, I would cut off her hand. Ibn Rumh's report says: The people before you were destroyed.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1688 b, book 29, باب قَطْعِ السَّارِقِ الشَّرِيفِ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالنَّهْىِ عَنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ فِي الْحُدُودِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ الْفَتْحِ فَقَالُوا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَلَّمَهُ فِيهَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أُسَامَةُ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَشِيُّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَطَبَ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ وَإِنِّي وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ يُونُسُ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَحَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهَا بَعْدُ وَتَزَوَّجَتْ وَكَانَتْ تَأْتِينِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأَرْفَعُ حَاجَتَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. The wording is Harmalah's. They said: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus ibn Yazid informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: 'Urwah ibn al-Zubayr informed me, from 'A'ishah, wife of the Prophet, that the Quraysh were concerned about the woman who had stolen during the Prophet's time in the year of the conquest. They asked who would speak to the Messenger of Allah about her, and said that only Usamah ibn Zayd, the beloved of the Messenger of Allah, would dare. She was brought to the Messenger of Allah, and Usamah spoke to him about her. The Messenger of Allah's face changed color and he asked whether Usamah interceded concerning one of Allah's limits. Usamah asked him to seek forgiveness for him. That evening the Messenger of Allah stood, praised Allah as He deserves, and said: The people before you were destroyed because when a high-ranking person stole, they let him go, but when a weak person stole, they carried out the prescribed punishment. By the One in whose hand is my soul, if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad were to steal, I would cut off her hand. Then he ordered that the woman's hand be cut off. Yunus said: Ibn Shihab said: 'Urwah said: 'A'ishah said: Afterward she repented well and married. She used to visit me, and I would take her requests to the Messenger of Allah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1688 c, book 29, باب قَطْعِ السَّارِقِ الشَّرِيفِ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالنَّهْىِ عَنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ فِي الْحُدُودِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَخْزُومِيَّةٌ تَسْتَعِيرُ الْمَتَاعَ وَتَجْحَدُهُ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدُهَا فَأَتَى أَهْلُهَا أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ فَكَلَّمُوهُ فَكَلَّمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَيُونُسَ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us: Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwah, from 'A'ishah, who said: A Makhzumi woman used to borrow goods and deny having them. The Prophet ordered that her hand be cut off. Her family went to Usamah ibn Zayd and asked him to speak to the Messenger of Allah on her behalf. He then related something like the hadith of al-Layth and Yunus.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1689, book 29, باب قَطْعِ السَّارِقِ الشَّرِيفِ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالنَّهْىِ عَنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ فِي الْحُدُودِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ سَرَقَتْ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَاذَتْ بِأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُطِعَتْ ‏.‏
en_text: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me: al-Hasan ibn A'yan narrated to us: Ma'qil narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, that a woman from Banu Makhzum stole and was brought to the Prophet. She sought protection through Umm Salamah, the Prophet's wife. The Prophet said: By Allah, if it were Fatimah, I would cut off her hand. Then her hand was cut off.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1690 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خُذُوا عَنِّي خُذُوا عَنِّي قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً الْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَنَفْىُ سَنَةٍ وَالثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَالرَّجْمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi narrated to us: Hushaym informed us, from Mansur, from al-Hasan, from Hittan ibn 'Abdullah al-Raqashi, from 'Ubadah ibn al-Samit, who said: The Messenger of Allah said: Take it from me, take it from me: Allah has made a way for them. For an unmarried man and an unmarried woman: one hundred lashes and exile for a year. For a previously married man and a previously married woman: one hundred lashes and stoning.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1690 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to us: Hushaym narrated to us: Mansur informed us, with this chain, with the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1690 c, book 29, باب حَدِّ الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كُرِبَ لِذَلِكَ وَتَرَبَّدَ لَهُ وَجْهُهُ - قَالَ - فَأُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَلُقِيَ كَذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذُوا عَنِّي فَقَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً الثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ وَالْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ الثَّيِّبُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ ثُمَّ رَجْمٌ بِالْحِجَارَةِ وَالْبِكْرُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ ثُمَّ نَفْىُ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us, both from 'Abd al-A'la. Ibn al-Muthanna said: 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Hittan ibn 'Abdullah al-Raqashi, from 'Ubadah ibn al-Samit, who said: When revelation came to Allah's Prophet, he was distressed by it and his face became troubled. One day revelation came to him in this state. When it had passed, he said: Take it from me, for Allah has made a way for them: a previously married woman with a previously married man, and a virgin with a virgin. The previously married are to receive one hundred lashes and then be stoned; the virgins are to receive one hundred lashes and then exile for a year.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1690 d, book 29, باب حَدِّ الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏"‏ الْبِكْرُ يُجْلَدُ وَيُنْفَى وَالثَّيِّبُ يُجْلَدُ وَيُرْجَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لاَ يَذْكُرَانِ سَنَةً وَلاَ مِائَةً ‏.
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Mu'adh ibn Hisham narrated to us: my father narrated to me. Both reported from Qatadah with this chain. Their wording says, The virgin is flogged and exiled, and the previously married person is flogged and stoned. They did not mention a year or one hundred lashes.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الثَّيِّبِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ عَلَى مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابَ فَكَانَ مِمَّا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ قَرَأْنَاهَا وَوَعَيْنَاهَا وَعَقَلْنَاهَا فَرَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجَمْنَا بَعْدَهُ فَأَخْشَى إِنْ طَالَ بِالنَّاسِ زَمَانٌ أَنْ يَقُولَ قَائِلٌ مَا نَجِدُ الرَّجْمَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَيَضِلُّوا بِتَرْكِ فَرِيضَةٍ أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ الرَّجْمَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى إِذَا أَحْصَنَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا قَامَتِ الْبَيِّنَةُ أَوْ كَانَ الْحَبَلُ أَوْ الاِعْتِرَافُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who said: 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Utbah informed me that he heard 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas say: 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said while seated on the Messenger of Allah's pulpit: Allah sent Muhammad with the truth and revealed the Book to him. Among what was revealed to him was the verse of stoning. We recited it, understood it, and retained it. The Messenger of Allah stoned, and we stoned after him. I fear that as time passes someone will say, We do not find stoning in Allah's Book, and they will go astray by abandoning an obligation Allah revealed. Stoning in Allah's Book is a truth for a man or woman who commits adultery after being married, when proof is established, pregnancy occurs, or there is a confession.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الثَّيِّبِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us; they said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, with this chain.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 c, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَنَادَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَتَنَحَّى تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ حَتَّى ثَنَى ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمَّا شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ دَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبِكَ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ أَحْصَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth ibn Sa'd narrated to me: my father narrated to me, from my grandfather, who said: 'Uqayl narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: A Muslim man came to the Messenger of Allah while he was in the mosque, called to him, and said, Messenger of Allah, I have committed adultery. He turned away. The man moved in front of him and repeated it; the Prophet turned away. He did this four times. When he had testified against himself four times, the Messenger of Allah called him and asked whether he was insane. He said no. The Prophet asked whether he had been married, and he said yes. The Messenger of Allah said, Take him and stone him.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 d, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَأَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ فَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ بِالْمُصَلَّى فَلَمَّا أَذْلَقَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ هَرَبَ فَأَدْرَكْنَاهُ بِالْحَرَّةِ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Shihab said: Someone who heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah informed me that he said: I was among those who stoned him. We stoned him at the prayer ground. When the stones hurt him, he fled, and we caught him at al-Harrah and stoned him.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 e, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَرَوَاهُ اللَّيْثُ أَيْضًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ خَالِدِ بْنِ مُسَافِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَيْضًا وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا جَمِيعًا قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَمَا ذَكَرَ عُقَيْلٌ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Layth also narrated it from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Khalid ibn Musafir, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, with the like of it. 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi narrated this to me: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us: Shu'ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, with this chain as well. Both reports say Ibn Shihab informed me that someone who heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah said what 'Uqayl related.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1691 f, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، وَابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ رِوَايَةِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me. Another chain: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us: Ma'mar and Ibn Jurayj informed us, all from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah, from Jabir ibn 'Abdullah, from the Prophet, with a report like 'Uqayl's narration from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayrah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1692 a, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ، حَرْبٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ حِينَ جِيءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ قَصِيرٌ أَعْضَلُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّهُ زَنَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى الأَخِرُ - قَالَ - فَرَجَمَهُ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا غَازِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ أَحَدُهُمُ الْكُثْبَةَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنْ يُمْكِنِّي مِنْ أَحَدِهِمْ لأُنَكِّلَنَّهُ عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kamil Fudayl ibn Husayn al-Jahdari narrated to me: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said: I saw Ma'iz ibn Malik when he was brought to the Prophet. He was a short, stocky man without an outer garment. He testified against himself four times that he had committed adultery. The Messenger of Allah said, Perhaps you only... He replied, No, by Allah, I really committed adultery. The Prophet had him stoned. Then he addressed the people: Whenever we set out to fight in Allah's way, one of you stays behind with a billy-goat-like bleat, giving one of them a little milk. By Allah, if I gain power over one of them, I will punish him severely for it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1692 b, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ قَصِيرٍ أَشْعَثَ ذِي عَضَلاَتٍ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ وَقَدْ زَنَى فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا غَازِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَخَلَّفَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَنِبُّ نَبِيبَ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ الْكُثْبَةَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يُمْكِنِّي مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ جَعَلْتُهُ نَكَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ نَكَّلْتُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ رَدَّهُ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us. The wording is Ibn al-Muthanna's. They said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Mu'adh ibn Hisham narrated to us: my father narrated to us, both from Simak ibn Harb, who said he heard Jabir ibn Samurah say: A short, unkempt, muscular man wearing a waist wrapper who had committed adultery was brought to the Messenger of Allah. He turned him away twice, then ordered that he be stoned. The Messenger of Allah said: Whenever we set out to fight in Allah's way, one of you stays behind bleating like a billy goat, giving one of them a little milk. If Allah gives me power over one of them, I will make him an example, or punish him severely. Simak said: I told this to Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said the Prophet turned him away four times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1692 c, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ وَوَافَقَهُ شَبَابَةُ عَلَى قَوْلِهِ فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَامِرٍ فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Shababah narrated to us. Another chain: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us: Abu 'Amir al-'Aqadi narrated to us. Both reported from Shu'bah, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah, from the Prophet, with a report like Ibn Ja'far's. Shababah agreed that he turned him away twice. Abu 'Amir's report says twice or three times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1693, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ أَحَقٌّ مَا بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا بَلَغَكَ عَنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ وَقَعْتَ بِجَارِيَةِ آلِ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us. The wording is Qutaybah's. They said: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Simak, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, that the Prophet said to Ma'iz ibn Malik: Is what I have heard about you true? He asked what had been heard. The Prophet said he had heard that he had been intimate with so-and-so's servant girl. He said yes. He testified four times, then the Prophet ordered that he be stoned.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1694 a, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ فَاحِشَةً فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِرَارًا قَالَ ثُمَّ سَأَلَ قَوْمَهُ فَقَالُوا مَا نَعْلَمُ بِهِ بَأْسًا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا يَرَى أَنَّهُ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُقَامَ فِيهِ الْحَدُّ - قَالَ - فَرَجَعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَرْجُمَهُ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ - قَالَ - فَمَا أَوْثَقْنَاهُ وَلاَ حَفَرْنَا لَهُ - قَالَ - فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْعَظْمِ وَالْمَدَرِ وَالْخَزَفِ - قَالَ - فَاشْتَدَّ فَاشْتَدَدْنَا خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عُرْضَ الْحَرَّةِ فَانْتَصَبَ لَنَا فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِجَلاَمِيدِ الْحَرَّةِ - يَعْنِي الْحِجَارَةَ - حَتَّى سَكَتَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَكُلَّمَا انْطَلَقْنَا غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَخَلَّفَ رَجُلٌ فِي عِيَالِنَا لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ عَلَىَّ أَنْ لاَ أُوتَى بِرَجُلٍ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ نَكَّلْتُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا اسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ وَلاَ سَبَّهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me: 'Abd al-A'la narrated to me: Dawud narrated to us, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, that a man from Aslam called Ma'iz ibn Malik came to the Messenger of Allah and said, I have committed an immoral act, so carry out the prescribed punishment on me. The Prophet turned him away several times. Then he asked his people, and they said they knew nothing wrong with him except that he had done something he thought only the punishment could expiate. He returned to the Prophet, who ordered us to stone him. We took him to al-Baqi'. We did not tie him up or dig a pit. We threw bones, clods, and pottery at him. He ran, and we pursued him until he reached the edge of al-Harrah. He stood there, and we threw large stones at him until he was still. That evening the Messenger of Allah stood and addressed the people: Whenever we set out to fight in Allah's way, a man stays behind among our families bleating like a billy goat. I pledge that if such a man is brought to me, I will punish him severely. He neither asked forgiveness for Ma'iz nor insulted him.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1694 b, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَمَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ إِذَا غَزَوْنَا يَتَخَلَّفُ أَحَدُهُمْ عَنَّا لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ فِي عِيَالِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Bahz narrated to us: Yazid ibn Zuray' narrated to us: Dawud narrated to us with this chain, with the same meaning. This report says that the Prophet stood in the evening, praised Allah, and said: What is the matter with people that whenever we go on an expedition, one of them stays behind, bleating like a billy goat? It does not say among our families.
